_comment: Site-wide settings. gaMeasurementId: your Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID (G-...), or empty for no analytics; a GA_MEASUREMENT_ID environment variable overrides it at build time. contactEndpoint and turnstileSiteKey: the contact form's Worker (worker/api) and the Cloudflare Turnstile site key (public); the contact page is built only when both are set. CONTACT_ENDPOINT and TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY environment variables override them. accountsApi: the accounts API (the same Worker's /v1, e.g. https://api.ravemonitor.com/v1), or empty to leave accounts off; ACCOUNTS_API overrides it.
